summary_en: Year-end dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised from 55.00 yen to 80.00 yen per share, a 45.5% increase, reflecting upward revision of full-year earnings forecast with consolidated operating profit now projected at 3.5 billion yen versus 2.7 billion yen previously.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Performance Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Sanyo Engineering & Construction has increased its year-end dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, from 55.00 yen per share to 80.00 yen per share, representing a 45.5% increase. This adjustment follows an upward revision of the company's full-year earnings forecast, with consolidated operating profit now projected at 3.5 billion yen (up from 2.7 billion yen) and net income attributable to parent company shareholders at 3.1 billion yen (up from 2.3 billion yen).

The company cited strong progress in electrical equipment construction for a data center project in Malaysia and improved profitability in major construction projects as factors supporting the higher earnings forecast. The dividend revision reflects the company's capital allocation policy, which aims for a dividend payout ratio of approximately 30% while maintaining a Return on Equity (DOE) of 2.0% or higher, thereby ensuring a stable financial foundation while generating funds for growth investments and providing appropriate shareholder returns.
